import math

enum Phase
    Idle
    Insurance
    Play

enum Finish
    Unfinished
    Ordinary
    Bust
    Surrender
    Charlie

enum Action
    Hit
    Stand
    Double
    Split
    Surrender

class Rules()
    hit_soft_17 := false
    pen := 75
    minimum := 10
    maximum := 500
    six_five := false
    das := true
    double_minimum := 0
    hands := 4
    rsa := false
    surrender := true
    charlie := 0
    side_maximum := 25

class Hand(int[] cards := [], bet := 0, split := false, split_aces := false)
    Finish finish := Finish.Unfinished

class Statistics()
    rounds := 0
    hands := 0
    wins := 0
    losses := 0
    pushes := 0
    blackjacks := 0
    busts := 0
    surrenders := 0
    doubles := 0
    splits := 0

class Player(name := "", bankroll := 0)
    bet := 0
    side := 0
    insurance := 0
    net := 0
    Hand[] hands := []
    stats := Statistics()

class Table()
    rules := Rules()
    players := array(7, fill = Player())
    Phase phase := Phase.Idle
    round := 0
    int[] participants := []
    insurance_turn := 0
    current_seat := 0
    current_hand := 0
    dealer := Hand()
    hole_visible := false
    dealer_natural := false
    dealer_blackjacks := 0
    dealer_busts := 0
    decks := 0
    int[] shoe := []
    random_state := 1
    drawn := 0
    running := 0

class Total(int value, bool soft)

void emit(string text)
    println(text)

string signed(int value)
    return if value >= 0 then "+{value}" else string(value)

int index_of(const string[] values, string target)
    for index := values.indices()[]
        if values[index] == target
            return int(index)
    return -1

bool contains(const int[] values, int target)
    for value := values[]
        if value == target
            return true
    return false

int | error integer_word(string word, int low, int high)
    if #word < 1 or #word > 10
        return error("bad value {word}")
    if #word > 1 and word[0] == "0"
        return error("bad value {word}")
    for code := word.codepoints()[]
        if code < 48 or code > 57
            return error("bad value {word}")
    value := int(word)
    if value < low or value > high
        return error("bad value {word}")
    return value

bool valid_name(string text)
    if #text < 1 or #text > 8
        return false
    for code := text.codepoints()[]
        if code < 65 or code > 90
            return false
    return true

int find_player(const Table table, string name)
    for: 0 <= seat < 7
        if table.players[seat].name == name
            return seat
    return -1

int[] seated(const Table table)
    return [for seat := (0:<7)[] if table.players[seat].name != "" then seat]

string[] rule_names()
    return ["DEALER", "PEN", "MIN", "MAX", "BJ", "DAS", "DOUBLE", "HANDS", "RSA", "SURRENDER", "CHARLIE", "SIDEMAX"]

bool | error parse_switch(string word)
    if word == "ON"
        return true
    if word == "OFF"
        return false
    return error("bad value {word}")

Rules | error change_rule(const Rules original, string name, string word)
    if index_of(rule_names(), name) < 0
        return error("unknown rule {name}")
    changed := original
    if name == "DEALER"
        if word != "S17" and word != "H17"
            return error("bad value {word}")
        changed.hit_soft_17 = word == "H17"
    elif name == "PEN"
        changed.pen = try integer_word(word, 50, 90)
    elif name == "MIN"
        changed.minimum = try integer_word(word, 1, 10000)
    elif name == "MAX"
        changed.maximum = try integer_word(word, 1, 10000)
    elif name == "BJ"
        if word != "3:2" and word != "6:5"
            return error("bad value {word}")
        changed.six_five = word == "6:5"
    elif name == "DAS"
        changed.das = try parse_switch(word)
    elif name == "DOUBLE"
        if index_of(["ANY", "9-11", "10-11"], word) < 0
            return error("bad value {word}")
        changed.double_minimum = if word == "ANY" then 0 elif word == "9-11" then 9 else 10
    elif name == "HANDS"
        changed.hands = try integer_word(word, 1, 4)
    elif name == "RSA"
        changed.rsa = try parse_switch(word)
    elif name == "SURRENDER"
        changed.surrender = try parse_switch(word)
    elif name == "CHARLIE"
        value := try integer_word(word, 0, 7)
        if not contains([0, 5, 6, 7], value)
            return error("bad value {word}")
        changed.charlie = value
    else
        changed.side_maximum = try integer_word(word, 0, 1000)
    return changed

string switch_text(bool value)
    return if value then "ON" else "OFF"

string rule_text(const Rules rules, string name)
    if name == "DEALER"
        return if rules.hit_soft_17 then "H17" else "S17"
    if name == "PEN"
        return string(rules.pen)
    if name == "MIN"
        return string(rules.minimum)
    if name == "MAX"
        return string(rules.maximum)
    if name == "BJ"
        return if rules.six_five then "6:5" else "3:2"
    if name == "DAS"
        return switch_text(rules.das)
    if name == "DOUBLE"
        return if rules.double_minimum == 0 then "ANY" elif rules.double_minimum == 9 then "9-11" else "10-11"
    if name == "HANDS"
        return string(rules.hands)
    if name == "RSA"
        return switch_text(rules.rsa)
    if name == "SURRENDER"
        return switch_text(rules.surrender)
    if name == "CHARLIE"
        return string(rules.charlie)
    return string(rules.side_maximum)

int point(int card)
    return math.min(card % 13 + 1, 10)

string card_text(int card)
    return "A23456789TJQK"[card % 13] + "CDHS"[card / 13]

Total hand_total(const Hand hand)
    value := [for card := hand.cards[] then point(card)].sum()
    soft := contains([for card := hand.cards[] then card % 13], 0) and value + 10 <= 21
    return Total(value + (if soft then 10 else 0), soft)

bool blackjack(const Hand hand)
    return not hand.split and #hand.cards == 2 and hand_total(hand).value == 21

string hand_text(const Hand hand)
    score := hand_total(hand)
    status := string(score.value)
    if blackjack(hand)
        status = "blackjack"
    elif score.value > 21
        status = "bust {score.value}"
    elif score.soft
        status = "soft {score.value}"
    cards := [for card := hand.cards[] then card_text(card)].join(" ")
    return "{cards} ({status})"

string hand_name(const Player player, int index)
    return "{player.name}[{index + 1}]"

void hand_line(const Table table, int seat, int index, verb := "")
    emit("{hand_name(table.players[seat], index)}{verb}: {hand_text(table.players[seat].hands[index])}")

int cut(const Table table)
    return int(#table.shoe) * table.rules.pen / 100

void shuffle(Table &table)
    table.shoe = [for index := (0:<int(52 * table.decks))[] then index % 52]
    for: int(#table.shoe) - 1 >= index >= 1
        table.random_state = 48271 * table.random_state % 2147483647
        other := table.random_state % (index + 1)
        temporary := table.shoe[index]
        table.shoe[index] = table.shoe[other]
        table.shoe[other] = temporary
    table.drawn = 0
    table.running = 0

int hilo(int card)
    value := point(card)
    return if 2 <= value <= 6 then 1 elif 7 <= value <= 9 then 0 else -1

int draw(Table &table, bool visible)
    card := table.shoe[table.drawn]
    table.drawn += 1
    if visible
        table.running += hilo(card)
    return card

void reveal_dealer(Table &table)
    if not table.hole_visible
        table.running += hilo(table.dealer.cards[1])
        table.hole_visible = true
    emit("dealer: {hand_text(table.dealer)}")

void finish_hand(Hand &hand, const Rules rules, int hand_count)
    value := hand_total(hand).value
    if value > 21
        hand.finish = Finish.Bust
    elif rules.charlie != 0 and int(#hand.cards) == rules.charlie
        hand.finish = Finish.Charlie
    elif value == 21
        hand.finish = Finish.Ordinary
    elif hand.split_aces and #hand.cards == 2
        again := hand.cards[0] % 13 == 0 and hand.cards[1] % 13 == 0 and rules.rsa and hand_count < rules.hands
        hand.finish = if again then Finish.Unfinished else Finish.Ordinary

string hand_result(const Table table, const Hand hand)
    if table.dealer_natural
        return if blackjack(hand) then "push" else "lose"
    if blackjack(hand)
        return "blackjack"
    if hand.finish == Finish.Bust
        return "bust"
    if hand.finish == Finish.Surrender
        return "surrender"
    if hand.finish == Finish.Charlie
        return "charlie"
    player_total := hand_total(hand).value
    dealer_total := hand_total(table.dealer).value
    return if dealer_total > 21 or player_total > dealer_total then "win" elif player_total == dealer_total then "push" else "lose"

int hand_profit(const Rules rules, int bet, string result)
    if result == "blackjack"
        return if rules.six_five then bet * 6 / 5 else bet * 3 / 2
    if result == "win" or result == "charlie"
        return bet
    if result == "push"
        return 0
    if result == "surrender"
        return bet / 2 - bet
    return -bet

void settle(Table &table)
    for seat := table.participants[]
        player := table.players[seat]
        for index := player.hands.indices()[]
            hand := player.hands[index]
            result := hand_result(table, hand)
            profit := hand_profit(table.rules, hand.bet, result)
            player.bankroll += hand.bet + profit
            player.net += profit
            player.stats.hands += 1
            if index_of(["blackjack", "win", "charlie"], result) >= 0
                player.stats.wins += 1
            elif result == "push"
                player.stats.pushes += 1
            else
                player.stats.losses += 1
            if result == "blackjack"
                player.stats.blackjacks += 1
            elif result == "bust"
                player.stats.busts += 1
            elif result == "surrender"
                player.stats.surrenders += 1
            emit("{hand_name(player, int(index))} {result} {signed(profit)}")
        emit("{player.name} bankroll {player.bankroll}")
        table.players[seat] = player
    for seat := seated(table)[]
        table.players[seat].bet = 0
        table.players[seat].side = 0
    table.phase = Phase.Idle

void dealer_turn(Table &table)
    reveal_dealer(&table)
    required := false
    for seat := table.participants[]
        for hand := table.players[seat].hands[]
            if hand.finish == Finish.Ordinary and not blackjack(hand)
                required = true
    drew := false
    if required
        while true
            score := hand_total(table.dealer)
            if not (score.value < 17 or (score.value == 17 and score.soft and table.rules.hit_soft_17))
                break
            card := draw(&table, true)
            table.dealer.cards = table.dealer.cards.append(card)
            emit("dealer hits: {hand_text(table.dealer)}")
            drew = true
    if drew and hand_total(table.dealer).value > 21
        table.dealer_busts += 1
    settle(&table)

void advance_hands(Table &table)
    while true
        found_seat := -1
        found_hand := -1
        for seat := table.participants[]
            for index := table.players[seat].hands.indices()[]
                if table.players[seat].hands[index].finish == Finish.Unfinished
                    found_seat = seat
                    found_hand = int(index)
                    break
            if found_seat >= 0
                break
        if found_seat < 0
            dealer_turn(&table)
            return
        table.current_seat = found_seat
        table.current_hand = found_hand
        if #table.players[found_seat].hands[found_hand].cards != 1
            return
        card := draw(&table, true)
        table.players[found_seat].hands[found_hand].cards = table.players[found_seat].hands[found_hand].cards.append(card)
        hand_line(table, found_seat, found_hand)
        finish_hand(&table.players[found_seat].hands[found_hand], table.rules, int(#table.players[found_seat].hands))
        if table.players[found_seat].hands[found_hand].finish == Finish.Unfinished
            return

void peek(Table &table)
    table.dealer_natural = blackjack(table.dealer)
    result := if table.dealer_natural then "blackjack" else "no blackjack"
    emit("dealer peeks: {result}")
    for seat := table.participants[]
        player := table.players[seat]
        if player.insurance == 0
            continue
        profit := if table.dealer_natural then player.insurance * 2 else -player.insurance
        player.bankroll += player.insurance + profit
        player.net += profit
        emit("{player.name} insurance {signed(profit)}")
        table.players[seat] = player
    if table.dealer_natural
        table.dealer_blackjacks += 1
        reveal_dealer(&table)
        settle(&table)
    else
        table.phase = Phase.Play
        advance_hands(&table)

void deal(Table &table)
    if table.drawn >= cut(table)
        shuffle(&table)
        emit("shuffle")
    table.round += 1
    emit("round {table.round}")
    table.participants = [for seat := seated(table)[] if table.players[seat].bet != 0 then seat]
    for seat := table.participants[]
        table.players[seat].bankroll -= table.players[seat].bet + table.players[seat].side
        table.players[seat].insurance = 0
        table.players[seat].stats.rounds += 1
        table.players[seat].hands = [Hand([], table.players[seat].bet)]
        card := draw(&table, true)
        table.players[seat].hands[0].cards = [card]
    table.dealer = Hand([draw(&table, true)])
    for seat := table.participants[]
        card := draw(&table, true)
        table.players[seat].hands[0].cards = table.players[seat].hands[0].cards.append(card)
        if blackjack(table.players[seat].hands[0])
            table.players[seat].hands[0].finish = Finish.Ordinary
    hole := draw(&table, false)
    table.dealer.cards = table.dealer.cards.append(hole)
    table.hole_visible = false
    table.dealer_natural = false
    for seat := table.participants[]
        hand_line(table, seat, 0)
    emit("dealer: {card_text(table.dealer.cards[0])} ??")
    for seat := table.participants[]
        player := table.players[seat]
        if player.side == 0
            continue
        first := player.hands[0].cards[0]
        second := player.hands[0].cards[1]
        same_color := contains([0, 3], first / 13) == contains([0, 3], second / 13)
        multiplier := if first % 13 != second % 13 then -1 elif first == second then 25 elif same_color then 12 else 6
        result := if multiplier == 25 then "perfect" elif multiplier == 12 then "colored" elif multiplier == 6 then "mixed" else "lose"
        profit := player.side * multiplier
        player.bankroll += player.side + profit
        player.net += profit
        emit("{player.name} side {result} {signed(profit)}")
        table.players[seat] = player
    upcard := point(table.dealer.cards[0])
    if upcard == 1
        table.phase = Phase.Insurance
        table.insurance_turn = 0
        emit("insurance offered")
    elif upcard == 10
        peek(&table)
    else
        table.phase = Phase.Play
        advance_hands(&table)

string action_problem(const Table table, Action selected)
    player := table.players[table.current_seat]
    hand := player.hands[table.current_hand]
    if selected == Action.Hit
        return if hand.split_aces then "split aces" else ""
    if selected == Action.Double
        if hand.split_aces
            return "split aces"
        if #hand.cards != 2
            return "two cards only"
        score := hand_total(hand)
        if (table.rules.double_minimum != 0 and (score.soft or score.value < table.rules.double_minimum or score.value > 11)) or (hand.split and not table.rules.das)
            return "double not allowed"
        if player.bankroll < hand.bet
            return "insufficient funds"
    elif selected == Action.Split
        if #hand.cards != 2
            return "two cards only"
        if point(hand.cards[0]) != point(hand.cards[1])
            return "not a pair"
        if int(#player.hands) >= table.rules.hands
            return "hand limit"
        if player.bankroll < hand.bet
            return "insufficient funds"
    elif selected == Action.Surrender
        if not table.rules.surrender or hand.split
            return "surrender not allowed"
        if #hand.cards != 2
            return "two cards only"
    return ""

Action recommendation(const Table table)
    hand := table.players[table.current_seat].hands[table.current_hand]
    can_split := action_problem(table, Action.Split) == ""
    if hand.split_aces
        return if can_split then Action.Split else Action.Stand
    up := point(table.dealer.cards[0])
    if up == 1
        up = 11
    if can_split
        value := point(hand.cards[0])
        wanted := contains([1, 8], value) or (value == 9 and not contains([7, 10, 11], up)) or (contains([2, 3, 7], value) and up <= 7) or (value == 6 and up <= 6) or (value == 4 and contains([5, 6], up))
        if wanted
            return Action.Split
    score := hand_total(hand)
    total := score.value
    can_double := action_problem(table, Action.Double) == ""
    if score.soft
        if total >= 19
            return Action.Stand
        if total == 18
            if 3 <= up <= 6
                return if can_double then Action.Double else Action.Stand
            return if contains([2, 7, 8], up) then Action.Stand else Action.Hit
        wanted := (total == 17 and 3 <= up <= 6) or (contains([15, 16], total) and 4 <= up <= 6) or (contains([13, 14], total) and contains([5, 6], up))
        return if wanted and can_double then Action.Double else Action.Hit
    if total >= 17
        return Action.Stand
    if total >= 13
        if up <= 6
            return Action.Stand
        if ((total == 16 and up >= 9) or (total == 15 and up == 10)) and action_problem(table, Action.Surrender) == ""
            return Action.Surrender
        return Action.Hit
    if total == 12
        return if 4 <= up <= 6 then Action.Stand else Action.Hit
    wanted := (total == 11 and up <= 10) or (total == 10 and up <= 9) or (total == 9 and 3 <= up <= 6)
    return if wanted and can_double then Action.Double else Action.Hit

Action parse_action(string word)
    if word == "HIT"
        return Action.Hit
    if word == "STAND"
        return Action.Stand
    if word == "DOUBLE"
        return Action.Double
    if word == "SPLIT"
        return Action.Split
    return Action.Surrender

string action_name(Action selected)
    match selected
        Action.Hit
            return "hit"
        Action.Stand
            return "stand"
        Action.Double
            return "double"
        Action.Split
            return "split"
        Action.Surrender
            return "surrender"

void perform_action(Table &table, Action selected)
    seat := table.current_seat
    index := table.current_hand
    player := table.players[seat]
    hand := player.hands[index]
    name := hand_name(player, index)
    if selected == Action.Split
        player.bankroll -= hand.bet
        player.stats.splits += 1
        emit("{name} splits {card_text(hand.cards[0])} {card_text(hand.cards[1])}")
        aces := hand.split_aces or point(hand.cards[0]) == 1
        first := Hand([hand.cards[0]], hand.bet, true, aces)
        second := Hand([hand.cards[1]], hand.bet, true, aces)
        player.hands = player.hands[0:<index].concat([first, second]).concat(player.hands[index + 1:<#player.hands])
        card := draw(&table, true)
        player.hands[index].cards = player.hands[index].cards.append(card)
        emit("{name}: {hand_text(player.hands[index])}")
        finish_hand(&player.hands[index], table.rules, int(#player.hands))
    elif selected == Action.Stand or selected == Action.Surrender
        hand.finish = if selected == Action.Stand then Finish.Ordinary else Finish.Surrender
        verb := if selected == Action.Stand then "stands" else "surrenders"
        emit("{name} {verb}: {hand_text(hand)}")
        player.hands[index] = hand
    else
        if selected == Action.Double
            player.bankroll -= hand.bet
            hand.bet *= 2
            player.stats.doubles += 1
        card := draw(&table, true)
        hand.cards = hand.cards.append(card)
        verb := if selected == Action.Double then "doubles" else "hits"
        emit("{name} {verb}: {hand_text(hand)}")
        finish_hand(&hand, table.rules, int(#player.hands))
        if selected == Action.Double and hand.finish == Finish.Unfinished
            hand.finish = Finish.Ordinary
        player.hands[index] = hand
    table.players[seat] = player
    advance_hands(&table)

void status_output(const Table table)
    heading := "table idle round {table.round}"
    if table.phase == Phase.Insurance
        heading = "table insurance round {table.round} next {table.players[table.participants[table.insurance_turn]].name}"
    elif table.phase == Phase.Play
        heading = "table play round {table.round} turn {hand_name(table.players[table.current_seat], table.current_hand)}"
    emit(heading)
    if table.phase != Phase.Idle
        emit("dealer: {card_text(table.dealer.cards[0])} ??")
    for seat := seated(table)[]
        player := table.players[seat]
        emit("seat {seat + 1} {player.name} bankroll {player.bankroll} bet {player.bet} side {player.side}")
        if table.phase != Phase.Idle and contains(table.participants, seat)
            for index := player.hands.indices()[]
                emit("{hand_name(player, int(index))}: {hand_text(player.hands[index])} bet {player.hands[index].bet}")

void statistics_output(const Table table)
    for seat := seated(table)[]
        player := table.players[seat]
        Statistics stats := player.stats
        emit("stats {player.name} rounds {stats.rounds} hands {stats.hands} wins {stats.wins} losses {stats.losses} pushes {stats.pushes} blackjacks {stats.blackjacks} busts {stats.busts} surrenders {stats.surrenders} doubles {stats.doubles} splits {stats.splits} net {signed(player.net)}")
    emit("stats dealer rounds {table.round} blackjacks {table.dealer_blackjacks} busts {table.dealer_busts}")

void | error command(Table &table, const string[] tokens)
    op := tokens[0]
    commands := ["SHOE", "RULE", "RULES", "PLAYER", "LEAVE", "REBUY", "BET", "SIDE", "DEAL", "INSURANCE", "HIT", "STAND", "DOUBLE", "SPLIT", "SURRENDER", "HINT", "AUTO", "STATUS", "COUNT", "STATS"]
    actions := ["HIT", "STAND", "DOUBLE", "SPLIT", "SURRENDER"]
    if index_of(commands, op) < 0
        return error("unknown command {op}")
    seat := -1
    amount := 0
    seed := 0
    Rules changed_rules := table.rules
    if op == "SHOE"
        amount = try integer_word(tokens[1], 1, 8)
        seed = try integer_word(tokens[2], 1, 2147483646)
    elif op == "RULE"
        changed_rules = try change_rule(table.rules, tokens[1], tokens[2])
    elif op == "PLAYER"
        if not valid_name(tokens[1])
            return error("bad name {tokens[1]}")
        amount = try integer_word(tokens[2], 1, 1000000)
    elif index_of(["LEAVE", "REBUY", "BET", "SIDE", "INSURANCE", "HIT", "STAND", "DOUBLE", "SPLIT", "SURRENDER", "AUTO"], op) >= 0
        seat = find_player(table, tokens[1])
        if seat < 0
            return error("unknown player {tokens[1]}")
        if index_of(["REBUY", "BET", "SIDE", "INSURANCE"], op) >= 0
            amount = try integer_word(tokens[2], if op == "REBUY" then 1 else 0, 1000000)
    if index_of(["SHOE", "RULE", "PLAYER", "LEAVE", "REBUY", "BET", "SIDE", "DEAL"], op) >= 0 and table.phase != Phase.Idle
        return error("round in progress")
    if op == "INSURANCE" and table.phase != Phase.Insurance
        return error("no insurance")
    action_command := index_of(actions, op) >= 0 or op == "AUTO"
    if action_command or op == "HINT"
        if table.phase == Phase.Idle
            return error("no round")
        if table.phase == Phase.Insurance
            return error("insurance pending")
        if action_command and seat != table.current_seat
            return error("waiting for {hand_name(table.players[table.current_seat], table.current_hand)}")
    if action_command
        if op == "AUTO"
            while table.phase == Phase.Play and table.current_seat == seat
                perform_action(&table, recommendation(table))
        else
            selected := parse_action(op)
            problem := action_problem(table, selected)
            if problem != ""
                return error(problem)
            perform_action(&table, selected)
        return void
    if op == "SHOE"
        table.decks = amount
        table.random_state = seed
        shuffle(&table)
        emit("shoe {amount} decks {#table.shoe} cards cut {cut(table)}")
    elif op == "RULE"
        if changed_rules.minimum > changed_rules.maximum
            return error("min above max")
        table.rules = changed_rules
        emit("rule {tokens[1]} {tokens[2]}")
    elif op == "RULES"
        fields := [for name := rule_names()[] then "{name} {rule_text(table.rules, name)}"]
        emit("rules " + fields.join(" "))
    elif op == "PLAYER"
        if find_player(table, tokens[1]) >= 0
            return error("player exists")
        empty := [for index := (0:<7)[] if table.players[index].name == "" then index]
        if #empty == 0
            return error("table full")
        seat = empty[0]
        table.players[seat] = Player(tokens[1], amount)
        emit("{tokens[1]} sits at seat {seat + 1} with {amount}")
    elif op == "LEAVE"
        player := table.players[seat]
        emit("{player.name} leaves with {player.bankroll} net {signed(player.net)}")
        table.players[seat] = Player()
    elif op == "REBUY"
        table.players[seat].bankroll += amount
        emit("{tokens[1]} rebuys {amount} bankroll {table.players[seat].bankroll}")
    elif op == "BET"
        if amount != 0
            if amount < table.rules.minimum or amount > table.rules.maximum
                return error("bet out of limits")
            if amount + table.players[seat].side > table.players[seat].bankroll
                return error("insufficient funds")
        table.players[seat].bet = amount
        if amount == 0
            table.players[seat].side = 0
            emit("{tokens[1]} bet cleared")
        else
            emit("{tokens[1]} bets {amount}")
    elif op == "SIDE"
        if amount != 0
            if table.players[seat].bet == 0
                return error("no bet")
            if amount > table.rules.side_maximum
                return error("side out of limits")
            if table.players[seat].bet + amount > table.players[seat].bankroll
                return error("insufficient funds")
        table.players[seat].side = amount
        if amount == 0
            emit("{tokens[1]} side cleared")
        else
            emit("{tokens[1]} side {amount}")
    elif op == "DEAL"
        if table.decks == 0
            return error("no shoe")
        participants := [for index := seated(table)[] if table.players[index].bet != 0 then index]
        if #participants == 0
            return error("no bets")
        deal(&table)
    elif op == "INSURANCE"
        waiting := table.participants[table.insurance_turn]
        if seat != waiting
            return error("waiting for {table.players[waiting].name}")
        if amount > table.players[seat].bet / 2
            return error("insurance out of limits")
        if amount > table.players[seat].bankroll
            return error("insufficient funds")
        table.players[seat].bankroll -= amount
        table.players[seat].insurance = amount
        if amount == 0
            emit("{tokens[1]} declines insurance")
        else
            emit("{tokens[1]} insures {amount}")
        table.insurance_turn += 1
        if table.insurance_turn == int(#table.participants)
            peek(&table)
    elif op == "HINT"
        emit("hint {hand_name(table.players[table.current_seat], table.current_hand)}: {action_name(recommendation(table))}")
    elif op == "STATUS"
        status_output(table)
    elif op == "COUNT"
        if table.decks == 0
            return error("no shoe")
        remaining := int(#table.shoe) - table.drawn
        value := math.abs(table.running) * 5200 / remaining
        decimals := string(value % 100)
        if #decimals < 2
            decimals = "0" + decimals
        sign := if table.running < 0 then "-" else ""
        emit("count running {table.running} true {sign}{value / 100}.{decimals} remaining {remaining}")
    elif op == "STATS"
        if #seated(table) == 0
            return error("no players")
        statistics_output(table)
    return void
